comment: The browser must see the API on the same origin as the app. api.js defaults to
a relative '/api' for exactly this reason: a cross-origin JSON POST is a
non-simple request, so every call would pay a CORS preflight round trip first.
This rewrite is the production equivalent of the dev-server proxy in
vite.config.js - Vercel forwards the request server-side, so the browser never
Replace REPLACE_WITH_BACKEND_URL below with the backend project's production
domain once it is deployed, e.g. https://euroguru-api.vercel.app
